title: Reporting Depth and Systems Integration Across the Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
Four depths of reporting suite are published across the tiers of the Corporate Travel Programmes, alongside five systems entitlements: the monthly savings report against published fares, the tracking and reuse of unused air tickets, programmatic access to the booking platform, single sign-on against the company's own directory, and delivery of booking data into the company's expense system.

The columns below carry the six tiers of the Corporate Travel Programmes in rank order: the Business Starter Programme, the Business Team Programme, the Business Pro Programme, the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme.

|  | Starter | Team | Pro | Enterprise | Enterprise Plus | Global |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Depth of the reporting suite | basic | basic | standard | advanced | advanced | enterprise |
| Monthly savings report against published fares | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Tracking and reuse of unused air tickets | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Programmatic access to the booking platform | Not included | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included |
| Single sign-on against the company's own directory | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included |
| Booking data delivered into the company's expense system | Not included | Not included | Included | Included | Included | Included |

## Annex notes

- **Reporting suite.** Four depths are published: basic on the Business Starter Programme and the Business Team Programme, standard on the Business Pro Programme, advanced on the Business Enterprise Programme and the Business Enterprise Plus Programme, and enterprise on the Business Global Programme.
- **Savings report.** The monthly report of what was paid against published fares is carried by the Business Pro Programme and every tier above it.
- **Unused air tickets.** Tracking and reuse of unused air tickets on the company's behalf is carried by the Business Pro Programme and above.
- **Programmatic access.** Carried by the Business Enterprise Programme, the Business Enterprise Plus Programme and the Business Global Programme alone.
- **Single sign-on and expense delivery.** Both are carried by the Business Pro Programme and above, and by neither of the two tiers below it.

## Points of judgement

**A company on the Business Team Programme asks what reporting it holds.** The basic reporting suite, with no savings report, no unused ticket management, no programmatic access, no single sign-on and no delivery of booking data into its expense system.

**A company on the Business Global Programme asks the same.** The enterprise reporting suite, together with the savings report, unused ticket management, programmatic access, single sign-on and delivery of booking data into its expense system.
